decision: ACCEPT strict sparse diagnostic use; insufficient as sole three-event association closure
scope: Read-only source inspection of restored sparse observer and two-witness plan; no runtime and no observer changes.
positive_boundaries: Runs actual config_to_ir and Diagram.to_html once per ordinary/sparse condition, preserves full events/native facts/IR/pages, validates present original claim proofs, and brackets source/input/tool/dependency bytes.

For a recognized omitted operand, the accepted link requires matching root document fingerprint, exact config path, fact owner/key, canonical value-status hash, default/checkpoint provenance, and a nonempty reader. Bare absent_default without a deciding hash cannot satisfy the link.

Fact values/kinds/completeness/unknown reasons, parameter summaries and ordered SVG bytes must remain equal; only finite exact metadata transitions get an admitted cause. Raw unexplained deltas remain FAIL.
Declaration-only positive facts are explicitly listed; the report states that parity is not proof qualification.

findings.issue: Default-use closure is existential: each omitted field needs at least one recognized proof+event link. It does not establish that every dependent fact/event for that operand is correctly linked. A width fact could satisfy a field while another dependency remains unlinked.
findings.effect: Raw PASS proves the admitted links and global parity checks, not complete per-consumer event accounting.

findings.issue: Matching events are filtered into a list; nonmatching additional events are not explicitly rejected, multiplicity is not constrained, and reader is required only to be nonempty. consumed, bound and absent_default intents are all eligible.
findings.effect: A correct event can coexist with a stale target/hash/reader event. Identical bad events across ordinary and sparse may escape delta comparison. The existing focused three-event tests cover a narrower explicit set but this observer alone does not.

findings.issue: proof_operands returns no operands for a declaration-only fact. Llama activation without an applied-function proof cannot supply the hidden_act link solely from corrected actual consumption and typed default-event evidence.
findings.effect: With no other qualified fact consuming hidden_act, the raw sparse check remains FAIL even if the activation association fix works. This must not trigger a fabricated or out-of-scope application proof.

findings.issue: The registered-constructor setup validates a typed constructor default, but the later linked-default predicate unconditionally requires that operand to exist in root_overlay. This is not the registered-constructor channel itself.
findings.effect: The SDXL route can remain conservatively red if constructor defaults are not in root_overlay. Do not reinterpret that as absent constructor proof or broaden the allowed delta set without a reviewed channel-specific join.

answer_to_root: A raw PASS would establish exact links for recognized proof-backed omissions plus the stated parity checks. It would not by itself close all three event-association issues or any stronger mechanism proof. Activation applied-function proof remains separately open; event agreement cannot qualify it.
recommended_use: Keep the current raw observer/result unchanged as a strict diagnostic.

Use the frozen new focused association controls for explicit targets; inspect actual Llama events for mechanism, composite head_geometry, and activation independently of whether their semantic proof exists.

If adding an acceptance observer, give it a separately reviewed exact event table: every intended target/premise event must carry the final canonical value/status hash and permitted producer/intent, and no extra stale target event may survive. Default premise evidence and stronger application proof must remain separate predicates.
Do not call sparse FAIL a product architecture regression when measured values/SVGs agree, and do not call architecture parity full value-ladder closure.
limitations: No tests/models/product modules executed by reviewer. No observed runtime outcome is asserted here.
No blessing, output delta acceptance, or S9-A completion is granted.
